stem.en: A voter who cannot see stands at the balloting unit. How can this voter find the right button without help?

text.en: By asking the next voter in the queue to point to it
By feeling the Braille number beside each button
By listening while an officer reads out each row
By bringing a printed list of names to the booth

explanation.en: Raised Braille numbers sit beside the buttons, so the voter can find a row by touch and press its button alone. Asking another person is help from someone else, and it also shows them the choice. A voter who cannot see cannot read a printed list.

hints.en: What can a finger find on the balloting unit?
